results.note: wrong constant: a real 64-hex OpenRouter key no longer matches, so it passes collect -- the exact risk the comment names
dropped alternative: sk-svcacct- keys are not caught by any other branch (the hyphen breaks the bare sk- run)
loosened type guard: "true" in quotes now passes as a truthy allowance, exactly what the comment forbids
wrong dict key: the allowance is never read, every entry gets allow_secrets=False and the type check never fires
boolean flip: allowed entries get scanned and refused, unallowed entries skip the scan
dropped early continue: a file with a credential hit is reported refused but still collected into the payload
allowance bypasses the hard deny -- the comment says an allowance is not a way past a deny
wrong config key in doctor: the env var NAME is passed as the key file path, so doctor reports a different route than a merge would take
comparison flip: --ai auto passes the literal "auto" through (unknown backend), an explicit --ai name is ignored in favour of config
dropped f-string field: the per-file path is gone from the allowed line, so the exemption is no longer named per file
wrong env constant: CCS_AI_MERGE_API_KEY_FILE in the environment is never read
removed guard: a preset that needs no key (local servers) now gets a <keys_dir>/<name>.env fallback, contrary to the docstring
wrong dict key: the named key file path is installed as the environment variable name instead of the file
dropped separator normalization: a backslash path yields the full path as identity, leaking the account name and splitting the cache by platform
off-by-one boundary: an empty quoted value ("") is no longer unquoted, so it reads as a present two-character token instead of absent
boundary widened: a multi-line file without the name now yields its first line as a guess, which the docstring says must never happen
reordered steps: the environment wins over the file named on purpose, breaking the fixed route order the docstring states
wrong mask constant: a group-readable key file (mode 640) is no longer flagged
